name: Landscape and Learning (L&L) Youth Aide
org: City of Sacramento Youth, Parks and Community Enrichment
what_you_do: You do paid weekend crew work in city parks, with training. Tasks include weeding, trimming, and leaf and trash removal.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17 living inside Sacramento city limits. Interview and work permit needed.
pay_detail: $16.90 per hour. Fall 2026 shifts: Sat and Sun 8:00 to 2:30.
deadline_text: The page said the Fall 2026 recruitment would begin in July 2026 and last two weeks or until 350 applications. That window is over. The next window is not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online only during a recruitment window using the Apply link on the L&L page. Selected applicants get an in-person interview, then hiring steps including a work permit. landscapeandlearning@cityofsacramento.org
notes: Fills fast because the window closes at 350 applications. Applications are online only during a recruitment window. Hiring includes getting a work permit. The page also lists a Crew Leader job ($21.83 per hour) that includes driving city vehicles. It states no age rule, so do not assume it is for teens.
